title: Order summary
brief: An order summary card: two line items with quantity and price, a shipping line, a rule, and a bold total.

inspiration.source: Shopify Polaris Text style and line items
inspiration.note: Took the pattern of left aligned names, muted meta and right aligned amounts in a stacked list; layout and palette redesigned.

inspiration.source: Stripe style checkout summaries on Dribbble
inspiration.note: Took the idea of a ruled total row with heavier type; all values and styling are ours.
